worldcombat.skill.lastresort.summary: The trump card: a slow, heaviest-in-the-set straight slam, unlocked only after every other implemented move the user knows has been used in battle. It hits harder the closer the user is to defeat, and spending it empties the ledger so it must be built up again.
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.use.0: Spend every other move first, then draw the trump card
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.use.1: Land the heaviest slam while nearly down
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.use.2: Turn the saved opening into one decisive blow
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.description: The straight slam deals about %1$s contact damage to the first enemy it meets on its path; the user's missing health is %2$s, so the less health left the harder it hits. The target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
It charges up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block radius, and knocks the target back %4$s blocks; if it hits nothing or terrain stops it early it whiffs and deals no damage.
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.desperation: Desperation form: power x1.12 and a longer charge, but a 3-tick slower wind-up, longer recovery and cooldown.
Steady form: base power and a slightly shorter charge, with a clean landing and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit. Unlocked only after every other implemented move the user knows has been used; trying it while locked lists the moves still missing. Spending it empties the ledger and it must be built up again, and about 30 s without using a move lets it lapse. A lone move (no other implemented moves) already satisfies the condition.
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.growth.0: From level %1$s the trump power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lastresort.growth.1: From level %1$s the trump power rises to %2$s and the charge to %3$s blocks.
On: stake everything (power x1.12, charge x1.1), but a 3-tick slower wind-up, 3 more recovery and 8 more cooldown, so the harder you commit the bigger the opening. Off: a slightly shorter charge and a clean landing with a shorter cooldown, good for a safe payout.
Only draw the trump card at a foe within this distance. The charge is medium, so larger values commit earlier; smaller values keep it to point-blank finishes.
world_combat.move.lastresort.text.missin: Still needs %1$s to unlock Last Resort
